visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of green stalks of millet swaying gently in a field under bright daylight, showing the healthy growth of the crop. (2) Aerial-style high-angle view revealing a vast, lush green agricultural landscape on Lanyu, surrounded by dense tropical foliage and rising mountains in the distance. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of three people standing amidst the tall grass; a man with sunglasses and a navy blue t-shirt gestures with his hands as he speaks to a young man in a black tank top and a woman in a bucket hat and black t-shirt. (4) Close-ups capture the expressive faces of the speakers, highlighting their smiles and engaged eye contact as they discuss the history of the crop. (5) The setting changes to a porch area with a "Welcome" sign on the wall; the man holds a basket of dried, dark-colored millet stalks, demonstrating their texture and appearance. (6) He then produces a small bottle containing liquid, gesturing toward it as he explains its origin. (7) Finally, the three characters raise white ceramic cups, clinking them together in a celebratory toast against the backdrop of the sunny outdoors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice provides a clear, mid-pitched narration with a friendly tone; upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar music with a steady rhythmic beat begins in the background. (2) The acoustic environment is clean, showing a field recording with very light ambient nature noise as the host introduces the black millet field. (3) Two other voices—one higher-pitched female and another male—interject with curious questions, their speech rates moderate and inflections rising with excitement. (4) Throughout the historical explanation, the BGM remains a consistent acoustic-pop track, maintaining a positive energy. (5) A sharp "ding" sound effect is used to highlight the reveal of the trade history between Lanyu and the Philippines. (6) The main speaker's voice shows high confidence as he explains the naming of the millet wine. (7) The recording captures the clear, resonant "clink" of ceramic cups hitting each other, followed by a synchronized vocal outburst from all three people cheering "Miminen!" to conclude the scene.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Historical Evidence -> Cultural Custom -> Toast
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the unique cultural and agricultural heritage of Lanyu (Orchid Island), specifically focusing on 'Black Millet'. It highlights the historical trade relations between the local people and the Philippines, the traditional use of millet, and the revitalization of millet wine culture through a conversational and interactive format.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines on-location field footage with historical anecdotes, using a lively host-guest dynamic to keep the content engaging for a social media audience.
